messages:
Jess (Support): hitting multiple customer reports - bulk of errors show API returning 500 during quota check. Customer logs: `quota-check -> 500` instead of 429. One customer on Dedicated is blocking. sample req id: req_0a7f3c. Can we triage? :eyes:
Mark (SRE): seeing spikes on api-gateway 5xx rate. Dashboards show a surge in `quota-orchestrator` downstream latency ~200-600ms then lots of 500s. Sending alert to eng-sre channel.
Priya (Orchestrator): thanks. Any recent rollout to quota-orch or rateplan? I can check commits and config.
Tom (Quota): we rolled a small change 40m ago to fallback behavior in quota-orch: if tenant lookup times out it used to return 429; new code tries a fallback path that can throw a 500 on certain tenant metadata. Could be that.
Emily (CS): affected customers include two enterprise accounts - one opened a ticket with support and is seeing live 500s on inference calls. They're sensitive to 5xx.
Jess (Support): repro steps from customer: curl example below returns 500 intermittently.
Jess (Support): ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer SK-XXXX" -H "x-customer-id: cust-42" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"quota_orch_error","message":"internal"}
```
Mark (SRE): can we correlate to dependency timeouts? Which backend is timing out first (redis? auth? rateplans)?
Tom (Quota): quota-orch depends on tenant-lookup (service tenant-svc) and redis for token buckets. Tenant-svc calls started timing out around the same window - 503/timeout. If tenant-svc times out we hit the new fallback, which appears to escalate to 500.
Priya (Orchestrator): I'm rolling back the fallback change to restore previous behavior (return 429 on missing tenant). Preparing rollback patch now. Will post the deploy id.
deploy-bot: rolling deploy started: deploy/quotaservice/2026-03-15-rollback-001 by Priya; tracking id dpl-7732
Mark (SRE): while rollback in progress, mitigation options: (1) increase instance concurrency for tenant-svc, (2) add a short client-side retry in gateway for 429/500? but that masks real problem, (3) temporarily enable cached tenant metadata in quota-orch to avoid lookup on hot paths.
Tom (Quota): enabling cached metadata for 60s now on a canary subset (10% traffic). Patching config: `TENANT_CACHE_TTL=60s` and `CANARY_RATIO=0.1`.
Jess (Support): pinging affected customers with note: investigating, possible temporary rollback, ETA ~15-30m.
Priya (Orchestrator): rollback applied to quota-orch: deploy dpl-7732 finished. Reverting fallback behavior.
deploy-bot: deploy dpl-7732 -> success; rolling restart of quota-orch pods completed in cluster-prod-us-west-2.
Mark (SRE): metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 4.6% to 0.2% on prod gateway within 3 minutes of rollback. Latency to tenant-svc also improved after we scaled its replicas (scaled from 3 -> 6).
Tom (Quota): cache canary also reduced errors for 10% traffic; leaving cache enabled for now while tenant-svc stability confirmed.
Emily (CS): customer confirmed that errors stopped after ~10 minutes. They're asking for RCA and timeline.
Jess (Support): collecting timeline and logs to produce customer-facing summary. Need root cause and action items to avoid recurrence.
Priya (Orchestrator): preliminary RCA: change in quota-orch fallback logic introduced an unhandled code path that converted tenant-svc timeouts into internal errors instead of returning 429. Contributing factors: tenant-svc had insufficient replicas and a transient upstream dependency (auth-token service) experienced elevated latency.
Mark (SRE): action items: (1) revert fallback (done), (2) add unit+integration tests to cover tenant-timeout to 429 mapping, (3) set tenant-svc HPA lower bound to 4, (4) add circuit-breaker + bulkhead for tenant-svc calls in quota-orch, (5) add alert when quota-orch 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
Tom (Quota): I'll own tests and the circuit-breaker work. PR incoming with tests + config bump.
Priya (Orchestrator): we should also add a synthetic check that verifies quota-orch returns 4xx for known rate-limit case - adding to canary suite.
Jess (Support): I'll send a customer update: short apology, explanation that a recent fallback change caused 500s during tenant lookup timeouts, we rolled back and scaled the dependent service, and we'll follow up with permanent fixes.
incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03-15-0213, priority P2, owners: Tom, Priya, Mark
Mark (SRE): closing loop — monitoring for 30m, will re-open if regression. Great triage + fast rollback. :thumbsup:
Emily (CS): thanks team, customers appreciate speed.
Jess (Support): thread summary into the incidents doc and customer notes will be posted after we finish RCA write-up.
Priya (Orchestrator): RCA write-up draft in #eng postmortems later today.
Tom (Quota): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/quotaservice/pulls/519 - adds tests + circuit-breaker.
Mark (SRE): last check at last_message_ts - 5xx rate stable at baseline. Closing incident after RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
